claim: Brazil's delegation to Web Summit 2025 was one of the two largest, along with Germany's, according to ApexBrasil.
Public figures for Brazil's 2025 Web Summit delegation range from 151 to "almost 380".
DN Brasil reported on 10 November 2025 that 151 participants were selected by ApexBrasil, with 80 from the Southeast and 35 from the Northeast.

Startups.com.br reported on 3 November 2025, quoting ApexBrasil, a figure of 340 startups and innovative companies: 256 selected by ApexBrasil and Sebrae and 84 by partners (Softex, Anprotec, Serpro).
Startups.com.br reported that 123 of the 340 companies were at Web Summit for the first time.
DN Brasil reported on 10 November 2025 that more than 370 startups based in Brazil were at Web Summit 2025.
ApexBrasil's rules for its 2026 mission give a 2025 figure of 247 startups and innovative companies supported by ApexBrasil, Sebrae and Serpro.
ApexBrasil's rules for its 2026 mission give a 2025 figure of almost 380 companies, including the 247 plus those of the state Sebrae branches.
Brazil's delegation to Web Summit in 2022 had 80 companies, the year of the first Brazil Pavilion, according to ApexBrasil speaking to Lusa and reported by Forbes Portugal on 7 November 2023.
Before Web Summit 2023, ApexBrasil planned a record of 85 startups and 100 companies, as reported by Forbes Portugal on 7 November 2023.
In 2024, 226 startups were selected by ApexBrasil and Sebrae for Brazil's Web Summit delegation, according to Startups.com.br on 3 November 2025.
For 2026, the estimated size of Brazil's Web Summit delegation ranges from 100 to about 300.
